conditions.evidence: the effects of ischemic stroke on cerebral vasoregulation
conditions.label: ischemic stroke

modalities.evidence: high resolution waveforms (ECG, blood pressure, CO2 and respiration)

output.population: 60 subjects who suffered strokes compared to 60 control subjects, elderly
output.summary: Multimodal recordings from a cross-sectional study of cerebral vasoregulation after ischemic stroke, collected over multiple days: transcranial doppler, 24-hour blood pressure, waveforms during movement tasks, 24-hour ECG, EMG, accelerometer, and gait pressure.
